analyst: The code uses a Day Shift Delta Volume Breakout entry that combines a volume-profile POC delta check, a VWMA slope filter, confirmation candles, and a pullback to the VWMA. Longs open when the required consecutive rising closes are confirmed, the POC delta is positive enough, the VWMA slope condition is met, and price returns within the pullback zone. Shorts open on the mirror conditions with falling closes, a negative POC delta, and a pullback toward the VWMA. The stop is a fixed dollar stop named stop_dollars, defaulting to $250, and the code also uses a take-profit named tp_dollars.
